file: POV - ASKING A MUSLIM TOURIST IF SHE FEELS SAFE IN ISRAEL - V1.mp4
title:
POV: ASKING A MUSLIM TOURIST
IF SHE FEELS SAFE IN ISRAEL 🇮🇱
people: Woman in a red hijab from Morocco, visiting Jerusalem
hook: And as a Muslim, do you feel safe in Israel? — Yeah, definitely. — Really? — Of course.
note: Ends at 80.4s on 'We should be able to live together. Yeah.' — before 'It's hard, though' (80.7s), so nothing sad or political is in. The confusing 'in Japan / from Japan in Morocco' exchange and Tal's 'they hate Israel because they never visit' are cut. Her one-word 'Thanks.' has no caption (the next line starts on top of it). 'I'm Jewish, and I'm so happy to see Muslims visiting here' is Tal speaking off-camera.
